entities.summary: Hindu Shahi, a notable figure in the history of Afghanistan, associated with Hephthalite and Turk Shahi Period (565–870). Preceded by Turk Shahi and Hindu Shahi Kabul and Hephthalites under Mihirakula devastate Buddhist monasteries across Gandhara.
